national_news.title: 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting Held in New Delhi
bullets: Union Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change Bhupender Yadav addressed the 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi.
The meeting concluded with the adoption of a Joint Ministerial Statement reaffirming commitment to the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development, UNFCCC, and the Paris Agreement.
India highlighted its BRICS Chairship priorities: Promoting Sustainable Lifestyles, Afforestation, Forest Fire Management, Disaster Resilience, Circular Economy, and Adaptation.

national_news.title: MEA Highlights Credibility of India's Election Machinery and Foreign Policy Updates
bullets: Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that the credibility and robustness of India's election machinery are well-established globally.
India offered condolences and expressed solidarity with Indonesia following a massive earthquake.
MEA reiterated India's firm stance against cross-border terrorism and ongoing energy cooperation discussions with Bangladesh.

national_news.title: Supreme Court to Form High-Powered Committee on Delhi Student Protests
bullets: The Supreme Court announced it will constitute a high-powered committee comprising retired judges, a former DGP, and an ex-CBI director.
The panel will conduct a fact-finding inquiry into allegations of police excesses against student protesters in Delhi and violence against police personnel.
The committee will also examine allegations of sexual assault, online harassment, and review CCTV footage of the July 20 Parliament march.

national_news.title: Iran States Strait of Hormuz Will Remain Closed Until Conditions Met
bullets: Iran announced that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed to maritime traffic until conditions under the 14-point MoU with the US are fully met.
Tehran's conditions include the complete removal of foreign sanctions and the cessation of military operations.
US President Donald Trump maintained that the strait remains open and operating under a US blockade.

national_news.title: Indian Shuttlers Advance at BWF Badminton World Championships
bullets: Indian ace shuttler Lakshya Sen advanced to the men's singles second round at the BWF Badminton World Championships after defeating Austria's Collins Filimon.
Women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand advanced to the pre-quarterfinals.
Unnati Hooda also advanced to the women's singles second round by defeating Myanmar's Thet Htar Thuzar.

national_news.title: Rishabh Pant becomes fastest and first Indian to hit 100 Test sixes
bullets: Rishabh Pant became the first Indian player and only the fourth in the world to hit 100 sixes in Test cricket.
He achieved this milestone in just his 51st Test match, making him the fastest player to complete 100 sixes in the format.
The milestone was reached during the first Test match of the series played in Galle against Sri Lanka.

national_news.title: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman Proposes Month-Long Youth Banking Campaign Starting October 2026
bullets: The Department of Financial Services (DFS) under the Ministry of Finance organized the two-day PSB Confluence 2026 in New Delhi.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced a focused, month-long campaign starting October 2, 2026, targeted at youth above 16 years to integrate them into the formal financial system.

A common online portal/application is envisaged to provide single-platform access to banking services, skilling, and entrepreneurship opportunities, coordinated via the Indian Banks' Association (IBA).

national_news.title: 97th Annual General Meeting of ICAR Society Emphasizes Integrated Farming for Small Farmers
bullets: Union Minister of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan chaired the 97th Annual General Meeting of the ICAR Society at NASC, New Delhi.
The meeting stressed integrated farming systems, timely availability of quality seeds, balanced fertilizer use, and enhanced soil health to diversify incomes of small and marginal farmers.
Union Minister of State Bhagirath Choudhary highlighted the goal of achieving self-reliance in pulses, oilseeds, seeds, and livestock to realize Viksit Bharat by 2047.

national_news.title: Agriculture Ministry Launches 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' Roadmap for Rural Development
bullets: A commitment program was organized in New Delhi for the Ministries of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Rural Development to implement the 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara' announced by the Prime Minister.
Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan administered a collective pledge to officials, scientists, farmers, and Lakhpati Didis to build a self-reliant and empowered India.
The roadmap focuses on moving beyond domestic production increases to ensuring quality, safety, and global market compliance for Indian agricultural products.

national_news.title: India's FTA Export Performance and Strategic Trade Growth Highlighted in PIB Report
bullets: India's combined merchandise and services exports reached a record US$ 863.1 billion in FY 2025-26, with merchandise exports at US$ 441.8 billion.
During April-June 2026 (FY 2026-27), combined exports grew by 11.37% year-on-year to reach an estimated US$ 232.73 billion.

The India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), enforced on May 1, 2022, emerged as India's largest individual FTA export market with merchandise exports worth US$ 37,359.11 million in FY 2025-26.

national_news.title: PIB Dehradun Organises Regional Media Workshop 'Vartalaap' in Chamoli
bullets: The Press Information Bureau (PIB), Dehradun, under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, organized the regional media workshop ‘Vartalaap’ in Gopeshwar, Chamoli district, on August 20, 2026.

The flagship outreach program aims to provide authentic information regarding Central Government welfare schemes, policies, and developmental journalism to media professionals in rural and border areas.
The workshop focused on key sectors including women, farmers, and youth empowerment, healthcare initiatives, GI tags, and the One District One Product (ODOP) scheme.

national_news.title: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports Announces National Sports Awards 2025
bullets: The Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports announced the National Sports Awards 2025, based on recommendations by a selection committee chaired by former Supreme Court judge Justice (Retd.) Arun Kumar Mishra.

Prominent sportspersons awarded the Arjuna Award for outstanding performance include Tejaswin Shankar (Athletics), Treesa Jolly (Badminton), Vidit Santosh Gujarathi and Divya Jitendra Deshmukh (Chess), among others.

The Dronacharya Award in the regular category was conferred on coaches Parveer Singh (Athletics), Chhote Lal Yadav (Boxing), and Neha Nandkumar Chavan (Shooting), while the Army Paralympic Node, Pune, received the Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar.

national_news.title: Indian Army Contingent Departs for India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV
bullets: The 15th edition of the India-Thailand Joint Military Exercise MAITREE-XV (2026) is scheduled from August 18 to 31, 2026, at Vibhavadi Rangsit Camp, Surat Thani, Thailand.
Both Indian and Royal Thai Army contingents comprise 85 personnel each, with the Indian side represented primarily by troops from the 9 Gorkha Rifles.
Instituted in 2006, the exercise focuses on joint counter-insurgency and counter-terrorist operations in jungle and semi-urban environments under Chapter VII of the United Nations Charter.

bihar_news.title: India's Carbon Credit Programmes and Smallholder Farmers in Bihar
bullets: Research based on smallholder farmers in Bihar highlights the need for upfront financial support in voluntary carbon credit programmes.
India accounts for around 4.1 percent of the global voluntary carbon market, while smallholders constitute over 80 percent of the farming population.

Key preferences identified among farmers include upfront financial support, technical training, and reduced compliance burdens to boost participation in the Indian Carbon Market and Green Credit Programme.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Joins Centre's Direct Pulse Procurement Network for the First Time
bullets: In a first, Bihar has joined the Centre's direct pulse procurement network allowing central agencies to purchase masoor directly from farmers.
Central agencies NCCF and Nafed have procured around 3,000 tonnes of masoor against a target of 32,000 tonnes, benefiting farmers at the MSP of ₹7,000 per quintal.
Bihar produces nearly 400,000 tonnes of pulses annually across 448,000 hectares, bypassing the state's abolished APMC system via direct bank account transfers.

bihar_news.title: Darbhanga Ranks Second in Bihar in Sugarcane IDs
bullets: Darbhanga has emerged as Bihar's second-highest district in obtaining Sugarcane IDs, with 24,215 farmers joining the sugarcane expansion campaign.
West Champaran holds the top rank in Bihar for the number of farmers with Sugarcane IDs.
The Sugarcane ID initiative aims to connect farmers with government departmental schemes, technical support, and cultivation-related incentives.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Resume Mining Operations After October 15, Announces CM Samrat Choudhary
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced that the state is set to resume mining operations starting October 15, 2026.
Over 30 out of 44 surveyed coal and mineral blocks will be allocated before September 30, with tender processes for 28 blocks currently underway.
Key mineral-rich regions identified for optimal utilization include Rohtas (limestone), Aurangabad, Jehanabad, Jamui, Gaya, Banka, and Bhagalpur.
